items.title: U.S. Postal Service plans 6% peak season surcharge for parcels
items.summary: The U.S. Postal Service on Tuesday proposed surcharges for domestic package delivery during the peak holiday season to cover extra handling costs, following the lead of large parcel carriers like FedEx and UPS that annually tack on holiday premiums. items.title: FedEx, Stock Of The Day, Eyes Buy Point — And A High-Margin Pivot
items.summary: FedEx is IBD Stock Of The Day after streamlining its parcel delivery and logistics businesses. Intraday, FDX stock eased near a buy point. In 2026, the Memphis-based company has shifted away from consumer parcel delivery to target higher-margin, business-to-business segments.

items.title: FedEx’s healthcare leader outlines next steps in sector growth plan
